items.name: a1_wind
items.pose: ATTACK 1 WIND-UP - twisting back toward the image left, the NEAR fist raised behind her near shoulder with its blade swung up to the upper left (never over the face), the far blade hanging at her side, feet planted apart.

items.name: a1_slash
items.pose: ATTACK 1 SLASH - pressing forward in a lunge, the NEAR blade cut down from the upper left to the lower right in front of her belly (its tip low on the image right), the far arm pulled back.

items.name: a2_wind
items.pose: ATTACK 2 WIND-UP - twisting toward the image right, the FAR fist raised above her far shoulder with its blade pointing up (above her head on the right, never over the face), the near blade hanging in front of her.

items.name: a2_slash
items.pose: ATTACK 2 SWEEP - the FAR blade swept across in front of her from the upper right (its tip pointing to the image right and a little down), the body pressing forward, the near blade swung back.

items.name: q_wind
items.pose: CUNNING SWEEP WIND-UP - squatting deep and low, BOTH arms spread out low to the sides, the two blades swung out at knee height on either side of her (their tips pointing outward and a little up), the chains swinging with them.

items.name: q_sweep
items.pose: CUNNING SWEEP - standing tall on her toes, BOTH arms flung straight out to the sides at shoulder height, the two blades sweeping out and up on either side (the near blade's tip to the upper left, the far blade's to the upper right), the far leg stepping forward.

items.name: q2_leap
items.pose: SUNDERING SLAM LEAP - jumping (the feet about 10 squares off the ground), BOTH blades raised high over her head together (their tips up and back to the upper left, never over the face), knees drawn up.

items.name: q2_slam
items.pose: SUNDERING SLAM - landing in a deep crouch, BOTH blades slammed down together onto the ground in front of her (on the image right, their tips on the ground line), the body thrown forward.

items.name: w_guard
items.pose: REPUDIATION BRACE - the FAR fist raised over her head holding its blade across above her head as a guard (the blade lying flat over the head, its tip to the image left, never over the face), the NEAR blade held across in front of her belly, hunched, knees bent, braced.

items.name: w_slam
items.pose: REPUDIATION SLAM - squatting deep, BOTH blades slammed down onto the ground on either side of her (the near one low on the image left, the far one low on the image right, their tips on the ground).

items.name: e_lash1
items.pose: LACERATE 1 - both arms flung out to the sides, the two blades WHIRLED OUT ON THEIR CHAINS and flying at her sides (the near blade out on the image left at waist height, the far blade out on the image right at shoulder height), each chain pulled straight from the fist to the blade's handle, turning a little to the right.

items.name: e_lash2
items.pose: LACERATE 2 - half a turn on, the arms swapped over, the blades whirled round on their chains to the other side (the near blade low on the image right, the far blade high on the image left above her head, never over the face), the chains pulled straight.

items.name: step
items.pose: DRAKEHOUND'S STEP - a dashing lunge forward to the image right, the body leaning far forward, the front leg bent, the back leg pushing straight, both blades trailing behind her (their tips low on the image left, off the ground).

items.name: r_grab
items.pose: PUBLIC EXECUTION GRAB - the FAR fist thrust high over her head, hoisting her victim (its blade in the fist, tip up), the NEAR blade hanging at her side, standing tall on her toes.

items.name: r_slam
items.pose: PUBLIC EXECUTION SLAM - dropping into a deep crouch, almost kneeling, the FAR hand driven down in front of her (pinning her victim into the ground on the image right), the NEAR blade hewn down onto the ground in front of her (its tip on the ground).

items.name: run1
items.pose: RUN 1 - a long stride: the FAR leg reaching forward with its foot landing, the NEAR leg stretched back, leaning forward, both blades trailing behind at her sides (tips low on the image left, off the ground).

items.name: run2
items.pose: RUN 2 - the near leg under the body carrying her, the FAR knee lifted forward, the body one square higher, both blades still trailing behind.

items.name: run3
items.pose: RUN 3 - a long stride: the NEAR leg reaching forward with its foot landing, the FAR leg stretched back, leaning forward, both blades trailing behind.

items.name: run4
items.pose: RUN 4 - the far leg under the body carrying her, the NEAR knee lifted forward, the body one square higher, both blades trailing behind.

items.name: d_kneel
items.pose: COLLAPSE - struck down onto both knees (the shins flat on the ground behind), the body sagging back, both hands opening and hanging, the two blades dropped flat on the ground at her sides.

items.name: d_slump
items.pose: SLUMP - still kneeling, slumping forward, the body bent over, the head low (never turned), both arms hanging limp to the ground, the two blades lying flat on the ground.
